Generate All Pairwise Contrasts

Source: R/Scheffe_test.R
pairwise_contrasts.Rd

Generate a contrast matrix containing all pairwise comparisons among groups. Each row represents one pairwise contrast, with a coefficient of 1 assigned to the first group and -1 assigned to the second group. All other coefficients are 0. The sum of all coefficients is zero.

Usage

pairwise_contrasts(group_names)

Arguments

group_names

A character vector of group names or group labels.

Value

A numeric matrix with one row for each pairwise comparison and one column for each unique group. Column names correspond to the group names. Each row contains one coefficient of 1, one coefficient of -1, and zeros elsewhere.

Details

The contrasts are generated in the order returned by utils::combn(), with the first group in each pair assigned a coefficient of 1 and the second group assigned a coefficient of -1.

The resulting matrix can be used to specify all-pairwise comparisons in multiple-comparison procedures, such as Scheffe's test.

See also

utils::combn()

Examples

groups <- c("g1", "g2", "g3", "g4", "g5")
pairwise_contrasts(groups)
#>       g1 g2 g3 g4 g5
#>  [1,]  1 -1  0  0  0
#>  [2,]  1  0 -1  0  0
#>  [3,]  1  0  0 -1  0
#>  [4,]  1  0  0  0 -1
#>  [5,]  0  1 -1  0  0
#>  [6,]  0  1  0 -1  0
#>  [7,]  0  1  0  0 -1
#>  [8,]  0  0  1 -1  0
#>  [9,]  0  0  1  0 -1
#> [10,]  0  0  0  1 -1

# Use the unique group names from a grouping vector
group_names <- c("Control", "Low", "High", "Control", "Low")
pairwise_contrasts(group_names)
#>      Control Low High
#> [1,]       1  -1    0
#> [2,]       1   0   -1
#> [3,]       0   1   -1
